messages:
Nia (People Ops): Quick question  Omar's H-1B was approved and he has an urgent family trip next week. Counsel recommends consulate stamping before travel. Can we expedite passport pickup and return so he can board on time?

Omar (New Hire): Trip is family emergency, flying out 2026-04-20. I have original passport here. Would prefer counsel handle stamping and return within 5 business days. Is that feasible?

Priyanka (Immig Legal): Welcome Omar. Fastest path is to courier passport to our NYC counsel for dropbox stamping if eligible. Dropbox + return can be 5-10 business days depending on consulate. We can request expedited handling and provide prepaid return. Need: passport, DS-160 confirmation, I-797, signed HR attestation. No notarization required.

Sam (Manager): From team side, need to sign off on time off if passport is withheld. Omar, can you be flexible with flight or do we need to risk travel before stamping?

Omar (New Hire): I'd prefer not to risk international travel without visa stamp. Can I change flight if required? I can but it's costly. Does company cover change fees in this situation?

Nia (People Ops): Per policy, if travel is for emergency we can reimburse reasonable change/cancel fees with receipts. For visa delays caused by admin processing we'll coordinate but not guarantee all fees. We'll treat this as immigration-related emergency, tag expenses "immigration-urgent".

Priyanka (Immig Legal): Action plan: 1) People Ops to arrange secure courier pickup today; 2) Omar to drop passport + docs at reception by 4:30pm; 3) Counsel to process as expedited and return passport via secure courier. I'll notify counsel and confirm ETA.

Reception (bot): Reception can accept sealed envelope labeled "Immigration - Priyanka" until 6pm. Please include a signed receipt and a contact number.

Omar (New Hire): Dropping docs at 4:20pm. One Q: do I include a pre-paid return envelope?

Priyanka (Immig Legal): Yes please include a pre-paid secure return label. We'll also add a backup return route (insured courier). Counsel will use the pre-paid label if compatible; if not, they'll return via our account and we will reimburse.

TravelOps (bot): Generated prepaid return label (Redwood account). Label ID: RED-TR-2026-881. Use for outbound package or keep as backup.

Nia (People Ops): I'll create the outbound DHL express label and DM it to Omar. Also will create an expense template for change fees in case flight needs to be rebooked.

Sam (Manager): Approving time off for any days Omar needs for appointments/shipping. Please keep me posted on actual days lost.

Omar (New Hire): Dropped at reception at 16:18. Reception handed me a receipt. Thanks!

Reception (bot): Received package labeled "Immigration - Priyanka" at 2026-04-09 16:18. Temporary receipt ID RCP-2026-441. Courier pickup scheduled 17:00 today.

Priyanka (Immig Legal): Confirmed with counsel: DHL tracking DHLEX-998877. Counsel estimates stamping eligible dropbox and return in 6 business days if no consulate RFE. I'll add to docket: H1B-STAMP-OMAR-2026 and set notification on any consulate requests.

Nia (People Ops): Action items: 1) Omar to upload flight change receipts if we reimburse; 2) Priyanka to update docket when passport returns; 3) I'll create Expensify template tag "immigration-urgent".

Omar (New Hire): Thanks everyone  will upload receipts if I change flight. One more: what if consulate requests original marriage cert for spousal name? Who pays notarization/translation?

Priyanka (Immig Legal): Good Q. If consulate requests additional docs, counsel will notify. Company covers reasonable courier/translation fees for required documents. Notarization usually employee responsibility but we can reimburse if tied to an urgent business travel need. We'll decide case-by-case.

TravelOps (bot): Shipment update: DHLEX-998877 picked up 2026-04-09 17:02. ETA counsel: 2026-04-16 10:00 ET.

Priyanka (Immig Legal): Logged shipment in case system. If passport returned before 2026-04-20, Omar should be fine to travel. If not, we'll escalate with counsel for emergency processing.

Nia (People Ops): Thanks team. Omar please ping us the moment you see "Delivered to counsel" or if you get any travel alerts. We'll stand by for receipts and any manager notes needed. :white_check_mark:
